title: Normalized supported reconstruction for actual tensor pullbacks
statement: Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] and $k:K\hookrightarrow X$ its complementary quasi-compact open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $u:S\to Z$ and $e:B\to Z$ be morphisms. Choose arbitrary commutative coefficient sheaves on $X,Z,S,K,B$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and specified coefficient isomorphisms for $i,u,k,e$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Use actual tensor pullback and direct image with their specified adjunction $i^*\dashv i_*$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], on module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose $F:\operatorname{Mod}(S)\to\operatorname{Mod}(Z)$ has an adjunction $F\dashv u^*$ such that its counit at $N$ is invertible whenever $e^*N=0$. In the geometric application, $u$ is the complementary open of closed $e$, and lem-sfb-proetale-identified-open-closed supplies this condition. For module sheaves $A$ on $X$, $M$ on $S$, an isomorphism $\sigma:u^*i^*A\cong M$, and support conditions $k^*A=0$ and $e^*i^*A=0$, there exists an isomorphism $\theta:A\to i_*F(M)$. It satisfies $u^*(\varepsilon_{i,F(M)}\circ i^*\theta)=\eta_{u,M}\circ\sigma$. Among all morphisms $A\to i_*F(M)$ it is the unique morphism satisfying this equation. It is natural in pairs of morphisms $a:A\to A'$ and $b:M\to M'$ commuting with the restriction isomorphisms: if $e^*i^*A'=0$ and $q':A'\to i_*F(M')$ has the analogous normalization, then $q'\circ a=i_*F(b)\circ\theta$.

source.place: Tag 09AH, lemma-ses-associated-to-open; Tags 09AA, 09BM and 09BN. Coefficient and adjunction transport use sites-modules.tex Tags 03DI and 03DJ and categories.tex Tag 0037. This is a composite consequence in the specified sheaf-of-modules presentation.

proof.text: Apply the actual identified-coefficient closed-essential-image theorem to the first support condition; the specified closed adjunction unit at A is invertible.

The second support condition and the open-counit hypothesis make lambda=F(sigma inverse) followed by the open counit invertible. Its closed adjoint transpose inverse, theta=closed unit followed by i_*(lambda inverse), is invertible. The closed Hom equivalence computes its transpose as lambda inverse.

Use the generic normalized-restriction and normalized-uniqueness adjunction algebra from supported reconstruction. The open triangle identity gives the restriction equation for lambda inverse. Any other morphism with that equation has transpose lambda inverse by cancellation; injectivity of the closed Hom equivalence proves uniqueness. For naturality, the compatibility equation and naturality of the open counit give F(b) followed by lambda prime equal to lambda followed by i^*(a). Cancel the two invertible lambdas and transpose this equality through the closed adjunction. Any normalized q prime has inverse lambda prime as its transpose by the same uniqueness argument.

theorem proEtaleIdentifiedSupportedReconstruction
    {X Z S K B : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (k : K ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion k] [QuasiCompact k]
    (u : S ⟶ Z) (e : B ⟶ Z)
    (hk : Set.range k = (Set.range i)ᶜ)
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (Ri : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Z) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (Rs : Sheaf (ProEt.topology S) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (Rk : Sheaf (ProEt.topology K) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (Re : Sheaf (ProEt.topology B) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (ci : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage i CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R ≅ Ri)
    (cu : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage u CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj Ri ≅ Rs)
    (ck : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage k CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R ≅ Rk)
    (ce : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage e CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj Ri ≅ Re)
    (F : proEtaleRingModules S Rs ⥤ proEtaleRingModules Z Ri)
    (ao : F ⊣ proEtaleRingModulePullback u Ri Rs cu)
    (hopen : ∀ N, IsZero ((proEtaleRingModulePullback e Ri Re ce).obj N) →
      IsIso (ao.counit.app N))
    (A : proEtaleRingModules X R) (M : proEtaleRingModules S Rs)
    (σ : (proEtaleRingModulePullback u Ri Rs cu).obj
      ((proEtaleRingModulePullback i R Ri ci).obj A) ≅ M)
    (hK : IsZero ((proEtaleRingModulePullback k R Rk ck).obj A))
    (hB : IsZero ((proEtaleRingModulePullback e Ri Re ce).obj
      ((proEtaleRingModulePullback i R Ri ci).obj A))) :
    ∃ θ : A ⟶ (proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage i R Ri ci).obj (F.obj M),
      IsIso θ ∧
        (proEtaleRingModulePullback u Ri Rs cu).map
          ((proEtaleRingModulePullback i R Ri ci).map θ ≫
            (proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction i R Ri ci).counit.app (F.obj M)) =
          σ.hom ≫ ao.unit.app M ∧
        (∀ q : A ⟶ (proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage i R Ri ci).obj (F.obj M),
          (proEtaleRingModulePullback u Ri Rs cu).map
            ((proEtaleRingModulePullback i R Ri ci).map q ≫
              (proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction i R Ri ci).counit.app (F.obj M)) =
            σ.hom ≫ ao.unit.app M → q = θ) ∧
        ∀ (A' : proEtaleRingModules X R) (M' : proEtaleRingModules S Rs)
          (σ' : (proEtaleRingModulePullback u Ri Rs cu).obj
            ((proEtaleRingModulePullback i R Ri ci).obj A') ≅ M')
          (_hB' : IsZero ((proEtaleRingModulePullback e Ri Re ce).obj
            ((proEtaleRingModulePullback i R Ri ci).obj A')))
          (q' : A' ⟶ (proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage i R Ri ci).obj (F.obj M')),
          (proEtaleRingModulePullback u Ri Rs cu).map
            ((proEtaleRingModulePullback i R Ri ci).map q' ≫
              (proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction i R Ri ci).counit.app (F.obj M')) =
            σ'.hom ≫ ao.unit.app M' →
          ∀ (a : A ⟶ A') (b : M ⟶ M'),
            (proEtaleRingModulePullback u Ri Rs cu).map
              ((proEtaleRingModulePullback i R Ri ci).map a) ≫ σ'.hom = σ.hom ≫ b →
            a ≫ q' = θ ≫ (proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage i R Ri ci).map (F.map b)
